text:
Noelle: Deploy-bot blocked the canary promote for service-api. CI verify failed on artifact upload: multipart ETag mismatch reported. Change window in ~35m. Quick call: pin to previous canary or attempt in-window rebuild+upload with cache-bust and verify? Logs below.

Deploy-bot: promotion-check failed for image redwood/service-api@sha256:3f2a1b
error: upload verification failed: multipart upload completed but computed ETag != observed ETag from registry
expected-manifest-digest: sha256:3f2a1b
registry-reported-digest: sha256:1a2b3c
action: promotion blocked; awaiting manual decision

Omar: Build logs show the final commit returned 200 but with a different ETag header. Could be S3-proxy rewriting or a truncated part during upload retries.

Keisha: If we retry now and the proxy is flaky, we could loop and exhaust the change window. Pinning to last good canary sha256:7e8d9f seems safest to keep the window. We can schedule a verified rebuild after we purge/confirm the proxy.

Build-bot: CI suggestion: rebuild with --upload-mode=single-part and --cache-bust to avoid multipart commit edge cases. Then run verify stage that pulls the manifest back from the same registry and asserts sha256 equality before any promote.

Theo: Agree with Keisha. Manual promote to previous canary keeps customers in the loop. Who can run the promote and watch smoke? I can take it. Command I will run:

/deploybot promote --image sha256:7e8d9f --env canary --meta "pin-multipart-etag-mismatch"

Noelle: Great. Also open an incident for s3-proxy-us-east and attach logs. If proxy was rewriting headers we need infra to investigate. Priya, can you open the rebuild PR with the single-part upload approach and the verification job?

Priya: On it. PR will include CI snippet:

ci/rebuild.yml:
  steps:
    - run: ./ci/build-image --tag=service-api:canary-rebuild --cache-bust --upload-mode=single-part
    - run: ./ci/upload --verify-manifest --atomic
    - run: ./ci/pull-and-verify --image=service-api:canary-rebuild --expected-sha256=3f2a1b

Omar: I'll open INC-2026-45 for s3-proxy-us-east and queue a restart + header-check. Also schedule a short TTL for runner-cache shards used by this pipeline.

Deploy-bot: Manual promote command received from Theo. Status: queued -> promoting -> smoke-run started. Will post progress.

Keisha: Release notes: add line to drafts/3.10.x: "Canary promotion paused due to multipart-upload ETag mismatch; pinned to previous canary sha256:7e8d9f while rebuild and registry investigation proceed." Include link to INC-2026-45 and the rebuild PR. Add rollback playbook link too.

Build-bot: Also recommend adding a short CI guard: if upload returns ETag different from local compute, fail fast and skip automatic promote. This will force manual review instead of noisy retries.

Deploy-bot: smoke-run at +5m: error-rate 0.21%, p95 latency stable. Temporary alert set: canary_http_5xx > 0.7% for 10m.

Theo: Watching. If smoke stays green for 15m I'll close the watch and mark change window used.

Priya: PR opened: "ci: rebuild service-api canary with single-part upload + verify". Adding verify stage that prevents promote until cross-registry manifest sha256 equals computed sha256.

Omar: INC-2026-45 created and assigned to infra. Purge job queued for runner-cache shards and s3-proxy restart scheduled in 7m. Attaching recent upload logs.

Deploy-bot: smoke-run passed. Promotion complete: canary now running sha256:7e8d9f (manual pin).

Noelle: Thanks everyone. Action items: Theo promote+watch, Priya PR + CI verify, Omar infra incident + purge, Keisha update release notes and link PR/incident, Build-bot add fast-fail ETag guard. We'll attempt verified rebuild off-hours and re-promote after clean verification. Reopen thread if any post-promote metric spikes.
